name: edge-human-signal-terminal
description: EDGE — Human Signal Terminal mobile wrapper

scripts.mobile:init: npm run mobile:build && npm run mobile:assets:source && npx cap add ios && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:assets: npm run mobile:assets:source && npx capacitor-assets generate
scripts.mobile:run:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.mobile:run:android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap run android
